build_accuracy_meter: build an AccuracyMeter with topk list to track top-k classification accuracy metrics
test_accuracy_meter_registry: test that meters.build_meter with name accuracy returns an AccuracyMeter instance
test_accuracy_meter_single_update: test AccuracyMeter update and reset with a single batch of model outputs and targets
test_accuracy_meter_multilabel: test AccuracyMeter with multilabel one-hot targets to verify top-k accuracy computation
test_accuracy_meter_distributed: test AccuracyMeter across distributed processes to verify correct aggregation of accuracy values
